edits.after: That time difference compounds across a three-night weekend, and it compounds faster with kids in the car. A five-hour drive turns a Friday into a wash, and a car seat and a tired toddler make it worse. Under three hours from DC means leaving after work on Thursday and still catching sunset over the water, a glass of wine in hand, before anyone's asking when they'll get there.
